demonstrates:
with 4000 tasks across 200 cases plus 4000 on one case, mixed statuses, priorities and assignment, and ANALYZE run: open-by-case used tasks_case_open_idx, the assignee queue used tasks_assigned_idx, the organisation-wide active read used tasks_org_open_idx, and a selective case history used tasks_case_history_idx. The counter-case is recorded: a single case holding roughly half the table is read by sequential scan. No latency, throughput or scaling claim is made. Plans:
{
  "open_by_case": "Sort  (cost=59.22..59.27 rows=18 width=26)
  Sort Key: priority_rank, created_at, id
  ->  Bitmap Heap Scan on tasks t  (cost=4.42..58.85 rows=18 width=26)
        Recheck Cond: ((case_id = 'ff64224a-6846-4ff6-b854-277f174c1047'::uuid) AND (status <> ALL ('{completed,cancelled}'::text[])))
        Filter: (organisation_id = 'de620792-3724-442b-9b0a-adb1a2c7a508'::uuid)
        ->  Bitmap Index Scan on tasks_case_open_idx  (cost=0.00..4.42 rows=18 width=0)
              Index Cond: (case_id = 'ff64224a-6846-4ff6-b854-277f174c1047'::uuid)",
  "assigned_queue": "Limit  (cost=0.57..228.46 rows=100 width=26)
  ->  Nested Loop  (cost=0.57..485.98 rows=213 width=26)
        ->  Index Scan using tasks_assigned_idx on tasks t  (cost=0.28..379.53 rows=1080 width=42)
              Index Cond: (assigned_to = '31a734a1-1fbf-468a-8da7-cf5f7a4ffdd1'::uuid)
              Filter: (organisation_id = 'de620792-3724-442b-9b0a-adb1a2c7a508'::uuid)
        ->  Memoize  (cost=0.29..0.40 rows=1 width=16)
              Cache Key: t.case_id
              Cache Mode: logical
              ->  Index Scan using cases_pkey on cases c  (cost=0.28..0.39 rows=1 width=16)
                    Index Cond: (id = t.case_id)
                    Filter: (workspace_id = ANY ('{bc93d1b4-d06f-49f8-aa6e-157ce780c8a4}'::uuid[]))",
  "org_active": "Limit  (cost=0.28..12.67 rows=100 width=26)
  ->  Index Only Scan using tasks_org_open_idx on tasks t  (cost=0.28..896.52 rows=7235 width=26)
        Index Cond: (organisation_id = 'de620792-3724-442b-9b0a-adb1a2c7a508'::uuid)",
  "case_history_selective": "Sort  (cost=59.23..59.28 rows=19 width=24)
  Sort Key: created_at, id
  ->  Bitmap Heap Scan on tasks t  (cost=4.43..58.82 rows=19 width=24)
        Recheck Cond: (case_id = 'ff64224a-6846-4ff6-b854-277f174c1047'::uuid)
        Filter: (organisation_id = 'de620792-3724-442b-9b0a-adb1a2c7a508'::uuid)
        ->  Bitmap Index Scan on tasks_case_history_idx  (cost=0.00..4.42 rows=19 width=0)
              Index Cond: (case_id = 'ff64224a-6846-4ff6-b854-277f174c1047'::uuid)",
  "case_history_dominant": "Sort  (cost=526.44..536.53 rows=4036 width=24)
  Sort Key: created_at, id
  ->  Seq Scan on tasks t  (cost=0.00..284.70 rows=4036 width=24)
        Filter: ((case_id = '94022de7-5996-47a9-824f-f154b3d3842b'::uuid) AND (organisation_id = 'de620792-3724-442b-9b0a-adb1a2c7a508'::uuid))"
}
